title: Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7 through 2.6.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
description: Bolo (bolo-solo) versions 1.7 through 2.6.4 are affected by a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts via the unsanitized commentOriginalCommentName parameter. Exploitation can lead to theft of non-HttpOnly session cookies from site visitors, potentially enabling attacker takeover of administrator accounts.
